title: Relative finite-clopen presentations of profinite spaces
statement: For every morphism E → S of profinite spaces in universe u there is a small cofiltered diagram in Profinite/S, with limit E → S, whose every object is isomorphic over S to S ×_C A for finite sets A,C and a surjective finite quotient S → C. Empty spaces and empty finite sets are allowed.

proof.text: Index by a finite clopen partition of E and a finite clopen partition of S compatible with E → S. Refinement is ordered componentwise. The trivial base partition supplies objects, and intersection of partitions supplies common refinements, so this is a small cofiltered category.

proof.text: For a compatible pair with finite block sets A,C take the explicit pullback S ×_C A. Refinement induces transition maps and E maps to the stage by its base point and source block.

proof.text: For any cone, the source coordinates belonging to the trivial base partition form a cone over all finite quotients of E. Mathlib Profinite.asLimit gives its unique source point. The other base partitions force its image in S to be the specified base point. Refinement determines every coordinate, proving the limiting property.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_relative_finite_presentation {S : Profinite.{u}} (E : Over S) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsCofiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Over S) (c : Cone D),
      c.pt = E ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ ∀ i : I,
        ∃ (A C : FintypeCat.{u}) (q : S ⟶ FintypeCat.toProfinite.obj C) (f : A ⟶ C),
          Function.Surjective q ∧
          Nonempty (D.obj i ≅ Over.mk (pullback.fst q (FintypeCat.toProfinite.map f)))
